item.title: FIFA To Award Record Prize Money To Women's Champions Cup Participants
item.description: FIFA Secretary General Mattias Grafstrom: A record-breaking prize money will be awarded to the inaugural FIFA Women's Champions Cup winner, the world football governing body announced on Saturday.

item.title: 2nd T20I: 'Never Saw Anyone Hit The Ball Like He Did,' Says Suryakumar Yadav On Ishan Kishan's Fiery 76
item.description: T20 World Cup: Indian skipper Suryakumar Yadav said the hosts want their batters to play with freedom and express themselves, hailing Ishan Kishan’s fearless strokeplay as a reflection of the team’s mindset after India beat New Zealand by seven wickets in the second T20I in Raipur on Friday.

item.title: Aus Open: Keys, Pegula Storm Into Fourth Round
item.description: Americans Jennifer Brady: American stars Madison Keys and Jessica Pegula set up an all-USA Round of 16 clash at the Australian Open after cruising through their third-round matches in straight sets on Saturday.

item.title: Ishan Kishan Credits Domestic Form for Match-Winning 76 in Raipur T20I Chase
item.description: Player of the Match Ishan Kishan said his prolific domestic season rebuilt confidence as he smashed 76 off 32 balls to power India’s record-breaking 209 chase against New Zealand in the second T20I in Raipur.

item.title: Aus Open: Musetti, Anisimova Storm Past Rivals To Enter Round Four
item.description: Margaret Court Arena: Amanda Anisimova and Lorenzo Musetti secured wins in their respective third-round games at the Australian Open against Peyton Stearns and Tomas Machac. While the former played at the Margaret Court Arena, the latter competed at the John Cain Arena on Day 7 of the first Grand Slam of the season.

item.title: Nepal Skipper Rohit Paudel Eyes New Summit With 'Nothing To Lose' At T20 World Cup

item.title: Aus Open: Outdoor Matches Suspended As Temperatures Hit 36°C
item.description: The Australian Open: The Australian Open's main showcourts at Melbourne Park had their roofs closed, and outdoor-court matches were suspended on Saturday under the tournament's extreme heat policy.

item.title: U19 World Cup: Match Officials For Super Six Stage In Namibia Announced
item.description: U19 World Cup: The ICC has announced the list of umpires and referees for the Super Six stage of the U19 Men’s Cricket World Cup 2026, set to take place in Namibia.

item.title: Aus Open: Sinner Overcomes Spizzirri, Darderi Upsets Khachanov To Set Up All-Italian Affair In Rd-4
item.description: Rod Laver Arena: Jannik Sinner’s Australian Open title defence was pushed to the brink on Saturday, but the World No. 2 dug deep to navigate extreme conditions and a fearless opponent, defeating American qualifier Eliot Spizzirri 4–6, 6–3, 6–4, 6–4 to reach the fourth round at Rod Laver Arena.

item.title: Amanjot, Pratika Earn Maiden Test Call For Aus Tour, Radha Yadav To Lead India A In Rising Stars Asia Cup
item.description: ACC Rising Stars Asia Cup: The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) announced the women’s squad for the one-off Test against Australia, with several new faces joining the Indian red-ball setup, as well as the India A squad for the upcoming ACC Rising Stars Asia Cup.
